question_text: Find the figure that completes the 3 x 3 matrix.

question_text: Find the figure that completes the 3 x 3 matrix.

question_text: Find the figure that completes the 3 x 3 matrix.

question_text: Find the figure that completes the 3 x 3 matrix.

question_text: Find the figure that completes the 3 x 3 matrix.
explanation: Overlay rule: in each row, a square position is black in the third cell only if it is black in exactly one of the first two cells (squares in both cancel out). Row 3: first cell TL, TR, BL; second cell TR, BR; TR cancels, leaving TL, BL, BR - option C. Why the others fail: (A) union of both (squares that overlap should cancel); (B) only the common squares; (D) squares of the first cell only; (E) squares of the second cell only.

question_text: Find the figure that completes the 3 x 3 matrix.

Why the others fail: (A) all squares of either cell; (B) squares in only one cell; (C) common squares of row 1 repeated; (E) wrong squares.
